responsibility: This file implements text_art::styled_string construction and parsing, especially conversion from UTF-8 and pretty-printer formatted text containing ANSI styling and URL escape sequences into vectors of styled_unichar cells. It owns the escape_code_parser state machine, interpretation of SGR and OSC sequences, handling of emoji variation selectors and combining characters, formatted-string helpers, width-aware string assembly, and selftests for parsing styled diagnostic text into renderable text-art content.
